method: One native reviewer, sequential independent local targets, hidden oracle, unchanged heads, no helpers or external model CLIs. Timings are wall-clock per case, not a paired comparison against the old workflow.

cases.name: case-a
cases.verification: Existing test passes; focused base/head reproduction proves cross-tenant leak at head.

cases.name: case-b
cases.verification: Existing test and focused enabled/disabled/absent flag, auth, empty cart and single-save checks pass.

limits: Two small synthetic cases, one reviewer, no statistical speed estimate.
No timed baseline run of the old review graph.
No evidence about large PRs, real review recall, production latency or overall coding-session speed.
Five-minute ordinary-review budget is a policy target, not a measured guarantee.
